import type { ProductsFilters } from "@/features/products/schemas/product-list-params.schema"

export const productKeys = {
  all: ["products"] as const,
  lists: () => [...productKeys.all, "list"] as const,
  list: (filters: ProductsFilters) => [...productKeys.lists(), filters] as const,
  categories: () => [...productKeys.all, "categories"] as const,
  detail: (id: number) => [...productKeys.all, "detail", id] as const
}

import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyTitle
} from "@/components/ui/empty"
import { ProductBackLink } from "@/features/products/components/ProductBackLink"
import * as m from "@/paraglide/messages"

/**
 * A product that does not exist, with the way back to the list: the detail page's own state, and
 * the page the framework shows with the 404 status.
 */
export function ProductNotFound() {
  return (
    <Empty className="border">
      <EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyTitle>{m.products_not_found_title()}</EmptyTitle>
        <EmptyDescription>{m.products_not_found_description()}</EmptyDescription>
      </EmptyHeader>
      <EmptyContent>
        <ProductBackLink />
      </EmptyContent>
    </Empty>
  )
}

import { z } from "zod"

/**
 * A product's id as a path segment holds it: a positive whole number written the plain way, so
 * `01`, `1.0`, `1e2` and `0x10` are not product pages.
 */
export const productIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/)
  .transform(Number)
  .pipe(z.number().int().safe())

export const productSortSchema = z.enum([
  "featured",
  "price-asc",
  "price-desc",
  "rating",
  "discount",
  "title"
])

// Only what a card shows: `select` asks DummyJSON for these fields alone.
const productSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  title: z.string(),
  // Groceries come without a brand.
  brand: z.string().optional(),
  price: z.number(),
  discountPercentage: z.number().default(0),
  rating: z.number(),
  availabilityStatus: z.string(),
  thumbnail: z.url()
})

const reviewSchema = z.object({
  rating: z.number(),
  comment: z.string(),
  date: z.iso.datetime(),
  reviewerName: z.string()
})

// Everything the detail page shows. Unknown keys are dropped, reviewer emails among them.
export const productDetailsSchema = productSchema.extend({
  description: z.string(),
  category: z.string().optional(),
  images: z.url().array(),
  tags: z.string().array(),
  sku: z.string(),
  stock: z.number(),
  dimensions: z.object({ width: z.number(), height: z.number(), depth: z.number() }),
  warrantyInformation: z.string(),
  shippingInformation: z.string(),
  returnPolicy: z.string(),
  minimumOrderQuantity: z.number(),
  reviews: reviewSchema.array()
})

export const productsPageSchema = z.object({
  products: productSchema.array(),
  total: z.number(),
  skip: z.number(),
  limit: z.number()
})

export const productCategorySchema = z.object({
  slug: z.string(),
  name: z.string()
})

export type Product = z.infer<typeof productSchema>
export type ProductDetails = z.infer<typeof productDetailsSchema>
export type ProductReview = z.infer<typeof reviewSchema>
export type ProductsPage = z.infer<typeof productsPageSchema>
export type ProductCategory = z.infer<typeof productCategorySchema>
export type ProductSort = z.infer<typeof productSortSchema>
